description: EMPRESAS PRESTATARIAS DE SERVICIOS PORTUARIOS is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Autoridad Portuaria de Cartagena. Companies that provide port services in the Port of Cartagena. The services provided are classified in Practicaje, Towage, Amarre y Desamarre, Reception of Waste, Passage, Merchandise Handling. Coverage: Autoridad Portuaria de Cartagena. The portal shows the English title as "ENTREPRENEURS OF PORTUGAL SERVICES" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Autoridad Portuaria de Cartagena. Its keywords include empresas. The listing shows 2 download or service links in HTML, SHEET. The listing shows 2023-09-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://datos.apc.es/wps/portal/open-data/Datos-APC-Condiciones-de-uso). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
